purpose: Grid-resolution check for the corrected fixed-boundary toroidal equilibrium screen.
diagnostic_scope: The two runs use the same prescribed geometric-rho pressure/current model, finite-difference Delta-star operator, radial-ray flux-surface extraction, and local Suydam/s-alpha proxy definitions.

runs.source_report: independent rerun of Tomahawk_MHD_FixedBoundary_Correction.py at 201 x 201

interpretation: The corrected edge-q ratio and ballooning proxy are stable across the two grids; the minimum Suydam D remains positive. This supports numerical repeatability of this screening diagnostic, not qualification of the device or proof of a self-consistent free-boundary equilibrium.
